programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Kayne and Kamill are in Queensland. Kayne's challenge is to fly -using a paraglider - with the White Bellied Sea Eagle. The Sea Eagle is a master glider and as a skilled hunter of large prey such as fruit bats.

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.sub_title: Somebody's Watching Me And Signed Sealed Delivered I'm Yours
programs.desc: Imaginative boy Ben transforms his city by bringing colorful street art to life, armed with a magic paintbrush — and the classic sounds of Motown.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: Julie meets Passifou, the little gannets' fool. She would like to keep him forever, but the baby gets bored and ends up running away.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: Our heroes are back in the village of Meo and Myra. There they meet Prince Alexis, who thinks peace is possible with Jes Mogokhs, but fails to convince the villagers.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Stanley asks 'What are clouds for?' and Grandpa spins one of his tall tales about his own Grandpa who used to fly his own cloud all over the world, rescuing naughty animals.

programs.title: Chums
programs.desc: The chums need to keep Emiree away from his beaver dam long enough to plan his surprise birthday party.
